source.note: Captures the Jina InboundTransformer.TransformRequest/TransformResponse round-trip for a basic string embedding with an explicit task. The Go inbound request test feeds an httpclient.Request whose Body is json.Marshal({model:'jina-embeddings-v3', input:'The quick brown fox', task:'retrieval.query'}) and asserts the resulting llm.Request has Model='jina-embeddings-v3', APIFormat=APIFormatJinaEmbedding, Stream==nil, and Embedding.Task=='retrieval.query'. The Go inbound response test feeds an llm.Response{Object:'list', Model:'jina-embeddings-v3', Embedding:{Object:'list', Data:[{Object:'embedding', Embedding:[0.1,0.2,0.3], Index:0}]}, Usage:{PromptTokens:5, TotalTokens:5}} and asserts the resulting httpclient.Response has StatusCode=200, Content-Type='application/json', and the body unmarshals to EmbeddingResponse with Object='list', Model='jina-embeddings-v3', len(Data)==1. selected_channel, outbound_http and upstream_http are null because the inbound-only unit test does not exercise those stages.

inbound_http._comment: Body is the JSON-marshal of the Go test's reqBody map literal ({model,input,task}). The Go test sets only Headers (Content-Type: application/json); no URL is asserted, so url is omitted.

unified_request._comment: Asserted llm.Request from the Go test 'valid string input with task': Model='jina-embeddings-v3', APIFormat=APIFormatJinaEmbedding, Stream=nil (not set), Embedding.Task='retrieval.query'. The Embedding.Input.String is 'The quick brown fox' (copied from the inbound body; the Go test does not explicitly assert Input.String for this subtest but it is the obvious mapped value).

client_http._comment: From TestEmbeddingInboundTransformer_TransformResponse subtest 'valid response'. Source llm.Response literal: Object='list', Model='jina-embeddings-v3', Embedding.Data=[{Object:'embedding', Embedding:[0.1,0.2,0.3], Index:0}], Usage={PromptTokens:5, TotalTokens:5}. The Go test asserts StatusCode=200, Content-Type='application/json', body unmarshals to EmbeddingResponse with Object='list', Model='jina-embeddings-v3', len(Data)==1. The body_json below mirrors the unified_response because the Jina inbound path passes the Jina-shape response through.
